meta_description:
163K likes, 746 comments - chrishemsworth on October 31, 2026: "Really excited to share the new looks of the @archierosedistillingco whisky collection.

I’ve loved being part of the Archie Rose family, and getting involved in designing these new bottles has been a pretty special experience. We wanted to create something that felt distinctly Australian, inspired by the rugged landscapes and natural beauty of home.

The Single Malt itself is the same award-winning whisky, proudly named Australia’s Best Single Malt five times. Crafted in Sydney, aged for at least three years and matured in a combination of Australian fortified wine, European and American oak casks. It’s got incredible depth and flavour, with notes of roasted pecans, tropical fruit, rich toffee and a touch of spice.

The Straight Rye Malt is the Two-Time Winner World’s Best Rye Whisky, made from the highest quality Australian Heritage, Vampire and historic Bevy rye malts. It is aged in air-dried and charred virgin American oak casks for at least three years in the maritime air of Sydney, with notes of candied almonds, tropical fruit, and nutmeg.

The new bottle is something I’m particularly proud of. A custom textured flask design that’s lighter, more sustainable and reflects the character of the whisky inside. We were inspired by being “forged from the earth” and the bottle shows that with its texture and unique shape.

Huge congratulations to the Archie Rose team. Proud to be part of the journey and excited for everyone to get their hands on it.

Available now across Australia, New Zealand and select retailers in the US. (Link in bio to grab yours)

Cheers! 🥃".
